notes: Worked example - 42 motorhomes + 12 caravans in the sample export. UK site (adria.co.uk) is Laravel+Livewire: range pages (e.g. /motorhomes/matrix) render empty; layout/trim/price data only loads via a scroll-triggered AJAX call to /livewire/update, so needs_javascript=yes. Full technical spec (weights, dimensions) is NOT in that JSON - it's in a per-configuration PDF at configure.adria-mobil.com/<market>/<period>/<product id>/pdf, itself a plain deterministic fetch once the product id is read out of the JSON. Campervans have a second index at /campervans. See docs/adapters/adria.md for the full write-up.
